findings.one_line: The proposed all-array uniform joint-coverage result is expressly left as an open question; the delivered regular-face calibration, width result, and diagnostics are a weaker kernel, so the note must either establish this comparison or recast its headline and theorem-level contribution to that weaker object.

The negative result refutes an internally described symmetric-probe certificate, but names no specific published paper, estimator, or workflow (with bibkey and claim) that uses the refuted method; it therefore does not yet clear the load-bearing negative-result novelty floor.

The claimed standalone method frontier is positioned only against generic inference classes; state its precise theorem-level difference from the closest published and accepted-bank results, and explain why the singleton-face oriented repair is a contribution rather than an internal proof diagnostic.
